data.gender_notes: Maridah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'maradah', which means 'to soften' or 'to make gentle'. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the gentle and nurturing nature of Allah towards His creation. The name Maridah carries the meaning “Gentle, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maridah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
